title: Configuring a shared container partition for the image-based upgrade

# Configuring a shared container partition for the image-based upgrade {#cnf-image-based-upgrade-shared-container-partition}

Your {{ sno }} clusters need to have a shared `/var/lib/containers` partition for the image-based upgrade. You can do this at install time.

**Additional resources**

- [Installing Butane](/openshift-docs-markdown/installing/install_config/installing-customizing#installation-special-config-butane-install_installing-customizing)
